title: When the Knowledge Runs Out: A Part-Level Pilot Evaluation of How Language Models Handle Partially Covered Questions
abstract: arXiv:2611.33428v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Assistants that answer from supplied reference material often receive material that covers some parts of a user's question and not others. Existing evaluations of insufficient context mostly score one answer per question, and often treat partially sufficient context as simply insufficient. We describe a small, open evaluation that scores each part of a three-part question separately, with a verdict for parts that are answered correctly from the material but carry an added unsupported claim. On 30 cases (five scenarios, six coverage patterns, five samples each) we test claude-haiku-4-5 and llama3.1:8b. Without an explicit instruction to stay within the material, both models fill most gaps from their own knowledge (unsupported-claim rates of 0.71 and 0.90). translated_title: 当知识耗尽时：语言模型如何处理部分覆盖问题的部件级初步评估
translated_abstract: 基于所提供参考资料作答的智能助手，往往收到的材料只覆盖了用户问题的部分内容而非全部。现有针对上下文不足的评估大多对每个问题仅给出单一评分，且常常将部分充分的上下文简单视为不充分。我们描述了一个小型、开放的评估方法，该方法对由三个部分组成的问题的每一部分分别评分，并对那些从材料中正确回答但又附加了无依据内容的部分给出判定。在30个案例（五个场景、六种覆盖模式、每种五份样本）上，我们测试了claude-haiku-4-5和llama3.1:8b两个模型。在没有明确指示只能基于材料回答的情况下，两个模型都会用自身知识填补大部分信息空白（无依据内容比率分别为0.71和0.90）。只需添加一句指示它们仅根据材料作答的话，这些比率即可降至0.00和0.06，这与先前的研究结果一致。剩下的是更不易察觉的问题：那些加强了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种对三部分问题逐部分评分的部件级初步评估方法，发现语言模型在参考资料仅部分覆盖问题时会默认用自身知识补充无依据内容（比率达0.71-0.90），而仅添加一句“只根据材料作答”的指令即可将该比率降至0.00-0.06。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a part-level pilot evaluation that scores each part of three-part questions separately, revealing that language models fill coverage gaps with unsupported claims from their own knowledge (rates of 0.71 and 0.90), which drops to 0.00-0.06 with just one sentence instructing them to answer only from the provided material.
